meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: Claude 可以加载、构建、分析基因组规模代谢模型，执行通量平衡分析、通量变异分析、基因/反应敲除、通量采样和生产包络分析等。
howto.when: 当用户需要分析代谢网络、模拟细胞代谢、进行代谢工程或优化生长介质时触发。

say.text: 帮我加载大肠杆菌核心模型并运行FBA。
say.note: 返回生长速率和通量分布。

say.text: 对这个模型进行单基因敲除分析。
say.note: 列出每个基因敲除后的生长情况。

say.text: 计算最小培养基以实现50%最大生长。
say.note: 返回所需的最小组分及其下界。

howto.what_en: Claude can load, build, and analyze genome-scale metabolic models, performing flux balance analysis (FBA), flux variability analysis (FVA), gene/reaction knockout, flux sampling, and production envelope analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to analyze metabolic networks, simulate cellular metabolism, perform metabolic engineering, or optimize growth media.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and run FBA.
say_en.note: Returns the growth rate and flux distribution.

say_en.text: Perform single-gene deletion analysis on this model.
Compute the minimal medium for 50% of max growth.
say_en.note: Returns required components and lower bounds.
